description: Legacy node name aliases for migration and reference

aliases.migrationNotes: Replace all references to kpdegen.working.balloo.su with kodegen.working.balloo.su in new documents. Legacy references retained for historical context only.
aliases.codegenHandling: AI codegen must use canonical name kodegen.working.balloo.su. Legacy alias should trigger warning if used in new code.
aliases.runtimeHandling: Runtime may accept legacy alias for backward compatibility but should log warning and redirect to canonical.
aliases.afterValidUntil: Reject legacy alias, require canonical name

policy.warningMessage: Legacy node alias used. Please update to canonical name: {canonicalNodeId}
policy.errorMessage: Legacy node alias expired. Use canonical name: {canonicalNodeId}
